network-config:
# Generated by RP Security (rp provisioning v1)
network:
  version: 2
  renderer: NetworkManager
  wifis:
    wlan0:
      dhcp4: true
      optional: true
      regulatory-domain: "TW"
      access-points:
        "Example \"Home\": Wi-Fi #2":
          password: "p@ss: w0rd'\"\\x"
rp-pairing.toml:
# One-time pairing secret; moved to /etc/rp and shredded on first boot.
secret = "fedcba9876543210fedcba9876543210fedcba9876543210fedcba9876543210"
user-data:
#cloud-config
# Generated by RP Security (rp provisioning v1)
hostname: "rp-garage"
manage_etc_hosts: true
timezone: "Asia/Taipei"

users:
- name: "admin"
  groups: users,adm,sudo,netdev
  shell: /bin/bash
  lock_passwd: true
  ssh_authorized_keys:
  - "ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIExampleKeyOnlyForTests test@example"

ssh_pwauth: false

runcmd:
- [rfkill, unblock, wifi]
- [raspi-config, nonint, do_wifi_country, "TW"]
- [systemctl, enable, --now, ssh]
- [install, -d, -m, "0755", /etc/rp]
- [install, -m, "0600", /boot/firmware/rp-pairing.toml, /etc/rp/pairing.toml]
- [shred, -u, /boot/firmware/rp-pairing.toml]
- [sh, -c, "set -e; exec >>/var/log/rp-firstboot.log 2>&1; curl -fsSL --proto =https --retry 20 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 5 -o /root/rp-install.sh https://github.com/Jest-Test-Team/rp_app/releases/download/v0.2.0-rc.1/install.sh; echo 'bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb  /root/rp-install.sh' | sha256sum -c -; bash /root/rp-install.sh --release v0.2.0-rc.1 --repo Jest-Test-Team/rp_app; rpctl setup --no-pairing; echo rp-firstboot: done"]
